name: Torre de San Martin
aka: Tower of the Church of San Martín

dates.altered: Restored in 1549 by Pierres Vedel, who reinforced one of the buttresses with ashlar; the lower section restored again in 1550 against damp erosion.
dates.note: The Aragon register heads the work 'Reforma. Siglo XVI' and dates it 1549; the English article says 'In 1550 its lower section was restored due to the erosion caused by humidity'. Both are recorded and neither is resolved.

refs.title: Mudejar Architecture of Aragon, component 378-003: 'Tower and church of San Martín (Teruel)'
refs.note: The component list is the English Wikipedia navigation box's for reference 378ter, inscribed 1986 and extended 2001.

refs.title: Torre de San Martín - Patrimonio Cultural de Aragón
¿Cuáles son los edificios más altos de Teruel y por qué miden lo mismo? - Heraldo
refs.note: Carried ONLY to record a figure this record deliberately does not take as a measurement. Two Aragonese press pages read the same day give the tower's height as about 40 metres (this one: 'También unos 40 metros es lo que mide la Torre mudéjar de San Martín'; idealista/news: 'Los 40 metros de alto'), and a third source read the same day gives 30. The register states no height, so none is parsed.

survey.prepared: Patrimonio Cultural de Aragón, the Government of Aragon's own heritage register. No author line and no revision date were printed in the extract.

quotes.text: Es ejemplo de la tipología de torre alminar almohade. Siguiendo esta estructura posee dos torres concéntricas, separadas casi un metro, entre las que se desarrollan pasillos y escaleras, que llevan a un campanario, cubiertos por bóveda de ladrillo. De planta cuadrada, da paso a una calle bajo su bóveda de cañón apuntado.
quotes.page: Patrimonio Cultural de Aragón, monument record, opening descriptive paragraph

quotes.text: La torre interior está  formada por tres estancias superpuestas, cubiertas por bóveda de crucería y de muros de ladrillo hasta la segunda estancia y en delante de tapial de yeso.
quotes.page: Patrimonio Cultural de Aragón, monument record, second descriptive paragraph; the double space after 'está' is the page's own

quotes.text: En 1549 fue reformada por Quinto Pierres Vedel, que reforzó uno de los estribos con piedra sillar.
quotes.page: Patrimonio Cultural de Aragón, monument record, under the heading 'Reforma. Siglo XVI'

measurements.name: stair_cavity_width_ft
measurements.note: The gap between the two concentric shafts, in which the stair runs -- 'almost a metre', converted at 3.28084 ft/m. The word is 'casi', so this is an upper bound the register itself hedges.

measurements.name: tower_shaft_count
measurements.note: The Almohad minaret type: a tower inside a tower with the stair between them, which is the structural fact this exemplar is in the node for.

note: Tranche 3, 5 Sep 2026. The survey is a REGIONAL register entry and it states no height, no plan dimension and no brick course; the only figure it gives is the width of the stair cavity. That is the shape of the evidence for Aragonese Mudejar from here.
